sources.title: Guideline for the pharmacological treatment of hypertension in adults
sources.intended_population: Adults, non-pregnant, appropriately diagnosed with hypertension and counselled about lifestyle modifications.
sources.supersession_check: The current WHO publication page describes this as its current evidence-based global guidance; no replacing edition is linked on the page as of retrieval. Owner should reconfirm before promotion.
sources.allowed_use: Non-commercial copying, redistribution, and adaptation with attribution; adaptations must use the same or compatible licence. Commercial use requires WHO permission and use must not imply WHO endorsement.
sources.third_party_material_warning: The PDF contains a third-party-material notice. Exclude third-party-attributed content unless separately cleared; do not use the WHO logo.
sources.scope_summary: Recommendations on pharmacological initiation thresholds, treatment target, follow-up intervals, first-line drug classes, combination therapy, laboratory testing, cardiovascular risk assessment, and non-physician initiation of therapy.

recommendation_sections.title: Blood pressure threshold for initiation of pharmacological treatment
Laboratory testing before and during pharmacological treatment
Drug classes to be used as first-line agents
Administration of treatment by non-physician professionals

sources.approval_scope: retrieval-corpus-only; may serve as context or distractor, not required gold evidence in E5-v1
review_caveats: Pharmacological-management document, not a general hypertension lifestyle guide.
Pregnancy-specific and emergency-setting sections require careful population filtering.

sources.title: WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
sources.intended_population: Children and adolescents aged 5–17; adults aged 18–64; older adults aged 65+; pregnant and postpartum women; adults and older adults with chronic conditions; people living with disability.
sources.supersedes: WHO Global Recommendations on Physical Activity for Health (2010), for the populations covered by this 2020 guideline.
sources.supersession_check: WHO continues to reference the 2020 global guideline for people aged 5 and older; separate under-five guidance is not a replacement for this population scope. Owner should reconfirm before promotion.
sources.allowed_use: Non-commercial copying, redistribution, and adaptation with attribution; adaptations must use the same or compatible licence. Commercial use requires WHO permission and use must not imply WHO endorsement.
sources.third_party_material_warning: The PDF contains a third-party-material notice. Exclude third-party-attributed content unless separately cleared; do not use the WHO logo.
sources.scope_summary: Evidence-based recommendations on frequency, intensity, and duration of physical activity and sedentary behaviour across age and selected clinical groups, including adults living with chronic conditions or disability.

recommendation_sections.title: People living with disability: physical activity
People living with disability: sedentary behaviour

sources.approval_scope: population-level public-health activity and sedentary-behaviour guidance only
review_caveats: Guideline is broad public-health guidance; individual exercise advice still depends on contraindications and clinical context.
PDF third-party content must be excluded or separately licensed.
WHO's current physical-activity page still lists the 2020 guideline as foundational; the 2026 wearable-measurement report concerns measurement guidance and is not a replacement edition.
Daily-step measurements are not interchangeable with moderate-to-vigorous physical-activity minutes.

sources.title: Total fat intake for the prevention of unhealthy weight gain in adults and children: WHO guideline
sources.intended_population: General adult population for recommendation 1; adults and children as scoped in the remarks to recommendation 2.
sources.supersedes: WHO Study Group guidance from 1989 and Joint WHO/FAO Expert Consultation guidance from 2002 on total fat intake.
sources.supersession_check: The current WHO publication page identifies this as updated guidance replacing the prior 1989 and 2002 WHO guidance; no newer total-fat guideline is linked as of retrieval. Owner should reconfirm before promotion.
sources.allowed_use: Non-commercial copying, redistribution, and adaptation with attribution; adaptations must use the same or compatible licence. Commercial use requires WHO permission and use must not imply WHO endorsement.
sources.third_party_material_warning: The PDF contains a third-party-material notice. Exclude third-party-attributed content unless separately cleared; do not use the WHO logo.
sources.scope_summary: Evidence-informed recommendations on total dietary fat intake to reduce unhealthy weight gain. The guideline addresses prevention and does not cover management of existing overweight or obesity.

recommendation_sections.title: Total fat intake for children and adults as scoped in the remarks

sources.approval_scope: population-level prevention of unhealthy weight gain; not treatment of existing overweight or obesity
review_caveats: Population-level prevention guidance; it must not be presented as treatment for existing obesity.
PDF third-party content must be excluded or separately licensed.

considered_but_not_selected.title: Guidelines on second- and third-line medicines and type of insulin for control of blood glucose in non-pregnant adults with diabetes mellitus (2018)
considered_but_not_selected.reason: Observed diabetes signals exist, but this source is specifically pharmacological escalation/insulin selection while the longitudinal input fields do not expose a medication-management task contract. Avoid widening the initial corpus beyond the directly supported prevention and measurement domains.

considered_but_not_selected.title: Risk reduction of cognitive decline and dementia: WHO guidelines, second edition (2026)
considered_but_not_selected.reason: The 202607 aggregate audit found no direct cognitive/dementia longitudinal signal. Do not select a source solely because it is new.

admission_rule: Only sources with review_status=APPROVED and owner_review_status=APPROVED may enter the active reviewed_guideline corpus. Source approval is separate from task_authoring_eligible; scope limits must be enforced by the task authoring contract.
promotion_blocker: Owner approval and exact recommendation-section retention are recorded; activation is blocked because the frozen BGE source-title smoke scored 8/10 for PUBLIC_HEALTH_ONLY. Two Chinese CDC title queries ranked their target sources at 18 and 15; frozen model and queries were not changed.
